exposure: termination of pregnancy for medical reasons
outcome: linking object or photograph given to parents
use of sedatives during hospital stay
cohort: 796 women who had experienced an intrauterine fetal death between sixteen weeks and birth
finding: Significant differences in care practices following intrauterine death were found based on gestational age and type of hospital, with poorer quality care provided for intrauterine deaths at earlier gestational ages.
mod_finding: 22.9% of births ≥26 weeks gestation were by caesarean, with a significant (p < 0.001) difference between public hospitals (16.8%) and private hospitals (41.5%).
